title: Retries wait too long when maxDelay is set
prompts: Users report that jobs with a retry policy that sets `maxDelay` wait far too long between retries. With baseDelay 100, factor 2 and maxDelay 1000, the second retry waited a full second instead of 200 ms, and every later retry waited exactly one second. Policies without maxDelay behave correctly. Find the cause and fix it, then run the tests.
notes: Planted bug in src/util/clamp.js (Math.max instead of Math.min). retry.js is the obvious place to look, the cause is one helper away. Visible tests never set a finite maxDelay.
